# ATS-Ready

> ATS-Ready is a web app that tailors a resume to a specific job description, scores it for applicant tracking systems (ATS), and writes cover letters and interview prep.  Paid plans are billed through PayPal.

## What it does
- Resume tailoring: paste a job description (or a public job-posting URL) and get a resume rewritten around that role's keywords, from a profile you maintain once.
- ATS score: a 0-100 score with a breakdown (keywords, skills, action verbs, formatting) and the matched and missing skills.
- Cover letters and interview prep: generated from the same profile and job description.
- Job suggestions: roles matched to your skills, location and experience.
- Import: upload an existing PDF or DOCX resume to fill your profile.

## Who it is for
Job seekers who apply to many roles and want each resume to match the posting without rewriting it by hand.

## Facts
- Free plan: 3 resumes per month. Cover letters and interview prep are Pro features. Paid plans are billed through PayPal.
- AI output can contain mistakes; users should review every document.
- Data can be exported or deleted by the user at any time in Settings.
